title: To require the Secretary of Energy to adopt model standards and best practices to support effective virtual power plant adoption, and for other purposes.

la.text: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committee on Science, Space, and Technology, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
